messages.uncached: Formulas with no saved value: {count}. Open the file in a spreadsheet program to calculate them.
messages.cellsCut: This workbook has more than {cells} cells, so later sheets are left out.
messages.too-large: This file is too large to preview (the limit is {limit}).
messages.unzip-limit: This file unpacks to more than {limit}, so it is not previewed.
messages.cells-limit: This file would make more than {cells} cells, so it is not previewed.
messages.nodes-limit: This file holds more content than the viewer can safely show, so it is not previewed.
messages.depth-limit: This file nests its content deeper than the viewer can safely read, so it is not previewed.
messages.timeout: Reading this file took too long, so it was stopped.
messages.failed: Could not read this file. It may be damaged or in a form this viewer does not read.
messages.encrypted: This file is protected with a password, so it cannot be previewed.
messages.gone: This file is no longer there.
messages.imagesDropped: Images left out: {count} (not embedded, an unsupported kind, or past the 20 MB the viewer shows).
messages.documentEmpty: This document has no text to show.
messages.presentationEmpty: This presentation has no slides to show.
messages.outlineCut: This file holds more text than the viewer shows, so the rest is left out.
